list.title: Authoring
list.caption: Your authoring sessions
list.empty: No sessions yet. Start one below, from a source that is ready.

new.title: New session
new.name: Name
new.noSources: You need a source that is ready to use first.

scope.title: Sources and scope
scope.label: Sections of {{title}} to use
scope.fixed: {{count}} sections in scope. The scope is fixed once there are questions.
scope.saved: Scope saved. The objectives start again from its headings.
scope.changed: {{titles}} has a newer revision. This session still uses the one it started from.
scope.revalidate: Check the quotes against the new revision
scope.revalidated: Quotes checked against the new revision.

objectives.title: Objectives
objectives.help: What the test should cover. Each one comes from a section, and cites the passages behind it.
objectives.label: Objective {{n}}
objectives.saved: Objectives saved. Set the blueprint again.
objectives.headingsOnly: No model is assigned to objectives, so the section headings stand.

blueprint.title: Blueprint
blueprint.help: A test type fills in defaults, and every number can be changed.
blueprint.mixSum: The types add up to {{sum}} of {{total}}.
blueprint.objectiveSum: The objectives add up to {{sum}} of {{total}}.
blueprint.styleHelp: A line added to the instructions, version {{version}}.
blueprint.constraintsHelp: For example: no questions on section 1.4.
blueprint.none: Choose a test type to start the blueprint.

generate.title: Generate
generate.cloud: Passages from your sources will be sent to {{endpoints}}, a cloud endpoint, and leave this instance.
generate.progress: {{written}} questions written, {{checked}} checked, {{pending}} still being checked.
generate.finished: Generation finished: {{count}} questions ready for review.

review.title: Review
review.heading: Question {{n}}: {{topic}}
review.template: This question has no values yet.
review.noPassages: No passage could be shown for this question.
review.blocked: This can't be accepted until the failed checks are fixed and it has an answer.

done.fix: Suggested answer applied to question {{n}}, and checked again.
done.chose: Answer for question {{n}} taken from the chosen program.
done.reclassified: Question {{n}} marked as not a calculation.

issues.multiple_correct: More than one option is marked correct ({{count}}).
issues.too_few_correct: A multiple-choice question needs at least one correct option.
issues.options_not_unique: Two options say the same thing.
issues.objective_unknown: It names an objective that isn't in this session.
issues.chunk_unknown: It cites a passage that was not sent to the model.
issues.not_computable_type: A {{type}} question can't be a calculation.
issues.options_from_model: A calculation came with options of its own.
issues.mistakes_count: A single-choice calculation needs 2 or 3 common mistakes, and has {{count}}.
issues.placeholder_undeclared: The question uses {{name}}, which has no input.
issues.input_unused: The input {{name}} isn't used in the question.
issues.no_placeholders: The question names no inputs, though it declares some.
issues.number_outside_placeholder: The number {{number}} is in the question text, not in an input or the quote.
issues.source_not_in_quote: The value for {{name}} isn't in any quote.
issues.true_false_options: A true/false question needs exactly True and False.
issues.not_one_true: Exactly one option must be correct.
issues.quote_not_found: A quote isn't in the passage it cites (match {{score}}).
issues.answer_in_question: The question may give away the answer.
issues.longest_always_correct: The longest option is the correct one on every question.
issues.all_or_none_of_above: An option says "all" or "none" of the above.
issues.number_in_explanation: The explanation has the number {{number}}, which isn't in the question or the passage.

l7.author: Writer's program
l7.suggested: Suggested answer: {{value}}. It is never applied without your confirmation.

fixDialog.title: Use the suggested answer?
fixDialog.body: The answer changes from {{from}} to {{to}}. It is checked again afterwards.

reclassifyDialog.title: Not a calculation?
reclassifyDialog.body: This skips the answer check. Say why, and it is kept in the question's history.

publish.title: Publish
publish.help: {{count}} of {{total}} questions are accepted. Only accepted questions go into the test, and a published version never changes.
publish.name: Name of the test
